contributions.title: BIO-Quantum Energy Brain (BQEB) Research Program
contributions.overview: A reproducibility-first modular research program for energy AI benchmarking and intelligent energy systems. Its connected research lineage comprises the BQEB Reproducibility Architecture, BQEB-Data, ForecastBench, SecBench, FoundationBench, ExplainBench, and TwinAgentBench. The architecture, dataset, executed forecasting benchmark, and subsequent benchmark specifications are distinct, independently citable research artifacts.
contributions.researchProblem: Energy AI research needs traceable connections between manuscripts, datasets, models, experiments, and benchmark protocols, with a clear distinction between specified infrastructure and executed experimental evidence.
contributions.motivation: Support independently verifiable research artifacts and comparative studies while preserving version history, citation lineage, and explicit evidence boundaries.
contributions.architecture: The four-layer BQEB Reproducibility Architecture comprises: (1) Research Artifact Layer, connecting manuscripts, datasets, models, and experiments; (2) Reproducibility Layer, using deterministic execution, checksummed artifacts, and an evidence registry; (3) Benchmark Evolution Layer, supporting benchmark extensions and comparative studies; and (4) Scientific Lineage Layer, managing citation tracking, version management, and DOI separation. The benchmark modules register within the existing Benchmark Evolution Layer; they do not introduce additional architectural layers.
contributions.technicalInnovation: Separates the architecture specification from its benchmark implementations and maintains lineage across independently citable artifacts. ForecastBench is the first validated benchmark implementation within the architecture. SecBench specifies a benchmark protocol; FoundationBench, ExplainBench, and TwinAgentBench define benchmark infrastructure without reporting executed model evaluations. ForecastBench validation does not establish experimental validation of the other modules.
researchContributions: BQEB Reproducibility Architecture (architecture specification): defines the four-layer framework connecting research artifacts, reproducibility evidence, benchmark evolution, and scientific lineage; the manuscript and archived software artifact have separate DOIs.

BQEB-Data (dataset): provides the program's open benchmark dataset foundation for autonomous energy intelligence and smart-grid analytics, retained as its own contribution and independently citable artifact.

ForecastBench (executed benchmark): the first validated benchmark implementation within the BQEB architecture, evaluating smart-grid forecasting tasks using BQEB-Data; retained as its own contribution.

BQEB SecBench (benchmark framework/specification): specifies reproducible cybersecurity and attack-detection evaluation for intelligent energy systems, including a threat model and benchmark protocol. Protocol specification is distinct from future benchmark execution; no trained or evaluated detection models are claimed here.

BQEB FoundationBench (benchmark framework/specification): specifies zero-shot and few-shot evaluation paradigms using existing ForecastBench forecasting targets, with a model registry and deployment-mode distinctions. The paper describes benchmark infrastructure, not executed model evaluation or experimental results.

ExplainBench (benchmark framework/specification): specifies reproducible, measurable explanation-quality evaluation for on-device agentic AI in energy systems, including faithfulness, stability, actionability, human interpretability, and uncertainty-awareness. It registers within the existing BQEB Benchmark Evolution Layer and reports no executed evaluations.

BQEB TwinAgentBench (benchmark specification): specifies joint evaluation of digital-twin fidelity and multi-agent coordination as distinct, diagnosable dimensions, with reproducibility requirements inherited from the BQEB architecture. It registers as the fifth module within the existing Benchmark Evolution Layer and reports no executed evaluations.
